reviews.title: Great value - surprisingly good performance!
reviews.comment: I bought this for my son.  It was an upgrade from a 2 year old system, DDR4, Ryzen 5000.  I migrated the 9070 graphic card over. I figured he would see a 30% improvement in gaming from the mb and CPU ... but based on FPS of Apex, ARC Raiders, and Expedition 33 ... it is literally 300% faster. Complaints - Boot time for set-up *slow*.  I thought we had a bad board or CPU... just had to wait like a minute, and only have one stick in, and it came up ..  No POST codes - rely on the on-board graphic for initial set-up. Memory slot selection was not intuitive, documentation was hard to find on-line with the detail that I wanted. It really would be 3 stars.  Maybe 4 with the price  ... but my son was so thrilled with the performance, and I was so surprised, that I am giving it 5. Do the BIOS update as soon as you start up. And if you get EXPO memory be sure to turn it on in BIOS.  Remember to order a cooler - I had everything else.
reviews.author: Stephen Kirby
